Veranta strategies in C++

Starting balance 10,000; 1% of the balance risked per trade at its stop; fee 1 basis point of notional at every fill; leverage 1. Equity is the balance plus open positions valued at each bar's close. Sharpe is avbt_cpp.sharpe: the mean of the daily equity returns, taken at each UTC midnight, divided by their sample standard deviation, times the square root of 365 (these markets trade every day), with a risk-free rate of 0. It is NaN with fewer than 30 daily returns. The last chart copies strategies 1 and 2 into one strategy on one ZORA account: the strategy that opens the position owns it, and the other's entries wait until it closes.
